This is an unresolved allocation/reconciliation question, not ordinary silence.
output.reasoning: The 12 March reply is an explicit already-paid-in-part claim that hinges on internal allocation of an unreferenced remittance. I cannot treat that as proof the balance is settled, but an automated chase repeating the full value is exactly what the payer says is wrong and would likely harden the objection. Someone needs to match the round-figure remittance against open items and answer the allocation question before any further pressure. The relocated shared-services centre and unanswered landline also mean phone contact is unlikely to reach the right person, and no reachable signatory is confirmed. Payment history shows this payer settles in full but habitually 40-85 days past due, so the lateness itself is consistent with their pattern rather than evidence of refusal. No dated promise-to-pay is stated; the shutdown reference is not a commitment. Uncertainty: I cannot see whether a remittance was actually received, so the allocation claim is unverified from this record.
